messages.text:
Hello, I got my OctAxe from you guys a few months ago and last night it quit on me.
This morning when I came to my living room, the screen and all fans were off and the black power cord was twitching every few seconds and it sounded like a dying mouse.
Please advise what can be done to get me back up and hashing asap.

Thank you,

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

Sorry about that. What you're describing, dead screen and fans with the cord clicking every few seconds, is almost always the power supply going into protection and restarting, not the miner itself. If you have another compatible PSU, try the OctAxe on that first. If it comes back to life, it's the PSU alone and we can send a replacement, no need to return the whole unit.

Either way, start the RMA here so we have it logged and get you a prepaid label if the unit needs to come back: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform . Processing takes up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse. One thing I have to ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered.

Your order Shop···· shows the OctAxe delivered August 24, so you're well inside the window. I'm confirming the exact warranty terms for your unit and a colleague will come back to you on that tomorrow from 10am ET.

For hands-on help right now, our Discord is the fastest route: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . Post in the server and mention JD (@nullhashrate), he answers the hardware.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi, I filled out the RMA last week and have not heard from anyone yet. I really need a new psu from you guys. I only have the freebie miner that came along with my OctAxe that’s running and I’m really disappointed it’s taking this long to get back up and running. Please help me out as soon as you can.
Side note in the RMA I disclosed I do not have access to a comparable psu to test my device and need you to send me one per the diagnosis I was given about the power supply.
I look forward to your response.
Best wishes,

Dillon J.
Handed to the team · RMA filed a week ago with no response; shipping a replacement part needs a perso

Hi Dillon,

Sorry you've been sat waiting on this, a week with no reply isn't good enough and I understand the frustration.

I've put your case straight in front of the team with the one thing you need: a replacement PSU for the NerdOctaxe sent out to your address in (address hidden), no return of the miner needed. You don't need a spare PSU to test with, the clicking cycle with a dead screen and dead fans is diagnosis enough for us to act on. They're offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow from 10am ET, and the confirmation with the shipping details comes to you by email here.

One thing that speeds it up: just confirm back that the OctAxe was never overclocked or modified, as that's the only thing that would change the outcome.

If you want a second pair of eyes on the unit in the meantime, our Discord is the fastest place for hardware, post in the server and mention JD (@nullhashrate): https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Nah, Never overclocked or modified in any way. I don’t know enough to mess with that stuff haha. I’m a simple plug and play guy.
Thank you for your help!

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

Perfect, that's exactly what I needed, and plug and play is the right way to run them anyway.

Your warranty cover is clean then, so nothing stands in the way of the replacement PSU. The team picks this up at 10am ET today and you'll get the confirmation with the shipping details by email here.

Nice that the little one is still stacking away in the meantime. I'll keep an eye on this until the PSU is moving.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi there, I’m writing to follow up on the power supply unit that’s supposed to be shipped to me. I haven’t received any tracking information or the package yet. Could you please let me know where we stand in the shipping process?

Thanks,

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

I've checked again and the honest answer is the same one you don't want: the PSU still hasn't been raised, so there's no tracking to send you. That's on us, not on you, and three chases is two too many.

The part itself is straightforward. Replacement parts go out as a free order from our side, so nothing is in question, it just needs a person to press the button and nobody has. I've escalated it by name this time rather than leaving it in the queue, with your address in (address hidden), the PSU only, no return of the miner.

The team is offline tonight and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the tracking email lands with you here as soon as the label is made.

Sorry, Dillon. You've been patient well past the point where you should have had to be.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Thanks for the update, Sarah. I appreciate you escalating the issue and I look forward to receiving the tracking information as soon as possible.
Feel free to have whomever drop a gamma and some stickers in the psu box ;)

The P. is the priority and it's with the team for tomorrow morning at 10am ET. Tracking comes to you here the moment the label is made.
